# Dreaming Anime

> Dreaming Anime is a Caribbean anime hub rooted in San Fernando, Trinidad and Tobago, covering anime news, official trailers, reviews, genre discovery, manga, cosplay, music, character spotlights, community events, figures and merchandise.

## Primary sections
- Homepage: https://dreaminganime.com/
- Blog and anime news: https://dreaminganime.com/blog/
- Genre discovery: https://dreaminganime.com/genres/
- Music Vault: https://dreaminganime.com/music/
- Character Spotlight: https://dreaminganime.com/character-of-the-week/
- Cosplay: https://dreaminganime.com/cosplay/
- Manga Vault: https://dreaminganime.com/manga/
- Reviews: https://dreaminganime.com/review/
- Community events: https://dreaminganime.com/hub/

## Editorial focus
Dreaming Anime prioritizes source-linked anime news, official trailers, practical discovery guides, character analysis, cosplay craft, anime music, and merchandise discovery for Caribbean and worldwide anime fans.

## Geography
Primary context: San Fernando, Trinidad and Tobago. Coverage: Caribbean and worldwide.
